/book.description: 7-step booking wizard for daycare, boarding, and grooming services

step-1.name: Service Selection
step-1.description: Choose service type: daycare, boarding, or grooming

elements.name: daycare-card
elements.expected: Selects daycare service and advances to step 2 (dog selection)

elements.name: boarding-card
elements.expected: Selects boarding service and advances to step 2 (dog selection)

elements.name: grooming-card
elements.expected: Selects grooming service and advances to step 1.5 (grooming sub-service)

step-1.5.name: Grooming Sub-Service Selection
step-1.5.description: Choose specific grooming service (only shown when grooming is selected)

elements.name: grooming-sub-service-option
elements.expected: Selects a specific grooming sub-service (e.g., bath, full groom, nail trim) and advances to step 2

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 1 service selection

step-2.name: Dog Selection
step-2.description: Select one or more dogs for the booking with inline add-dog capability

elements.name: dog-checkbox
elements.expected: Toggles dog selection. Multiple dogs can be selected.

elements.name: add-dog-button
elements.selector: button:has-text('Add Dog'), button:has-text('Add Pet'), button:has-text('Add a Dog'), [data-testid='add-dog-inline']
elements.expected: Opens inline form or modal to add a new dog without leaving the wizard

elements.name: add-dog-form
elements.expected: Displays inline dog registration form with name, breed, weight, etc.

elements.name: next-button
elements.expected: Advances to step 3 (date selection) with at least one dog selected

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 1 or step 1.5

step-3.name: Date Selection
step-3.description: Select booking date(s) using a calendar component

elements.name: calendar
elements.expected: Displays interactive calendar showing available dates

elements.name: calendar-date
elements.expected: Selects a date. Unavailable dates should be disabled/unclickable.

elements.name: next-button
elements.expected: Advances to step 4 (time selection for grooming) or step 6 (bundle upsell for daycare/boarding)

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 2 dog selection

elements.name: time-slot
elements.expected: Selects an available time slot for the grooming appointment

elements.name: next-button
elements.expected: Advances to step 5 (photo upload for coat-related grooming) or step 6 (bundle upsell)

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 3 date selection

step-5.name: Photo Upload
step-5.description: Upload coat/style reference photo (coat-related grooming services only)

elements.name: photo-upload-input
elements.expected: Opens file picker for photo upload. Accepts image files.

elements.name: photo-preview
elements.expected: Shows thumbnail preview of uploaded photo

elements.name: skip-button
elements.expected: Skips photo upload and advances to step 6

elements.name: next-button
elements.expected: Advances to step 6 (bundle upsell) with or without photo

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 4 time selection

elements.name: bundle-option
elements.expected: Selects or deselects a bundle add-on offer

elements.name: skip-button
elements.expected: Skips bundle selection and advances to step 7 review

elements.name: next-button
elements.expected: Advances to step 7 (review & confirm) with selected bundles

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to previous step

step-7.name: Review & Confirm
step-7.description: Final review of all booking details before confirmation

elements.name: booking-summary
elements.expected: Displays full booking summary: service, dog(s), date, time, add-ons, and total price

elements.name: confirm-button
elements.expected: Confirms booking and redirects to /checkout/:bookingId for payment

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to step 6 to modify selections
